answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 6958 Country: India Title: As our deen and dunia are not separate our works if done by order of ALLAH and by the way of prophet (sws) it is deen. What is the order of ALLAH and way of prophet(sws) in the studies we take as college, degree, masters. A 'MAJOR' part of our life is spent in it how should our Aakhirah be prepared? I am very much confused DO REPLY EARLY. Question: As our deen and dunia are not separate our works if done by order of ALLAH and by the way of prophet (sws) it is deen. What is the order of ALLAH and way of prophet(sws) in the studies we take as college, degree, masters. A 'MAJOR' part of our life is spent in it how should our Aakhirah be prepared? I am very much confused DO REPLY EARLY. Answer ID: 6958 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 934/885=D-1429) Duration education, you should abstain form unlawful things specially sins. Do your best to act upon Islamic rulings, be mindful of salah and other worship, render dealings and social works. Acquire education with good intention e.g. to earn income thorough lawful ways doing proper jobs and to spend the money on wife, children, relatives, the poor and for good deeds, to preach the religion of Islam and convey the message to people of other faith, to benefit Islam, Muslims as well as humanity in every possible way thorough the education. Following the abovementioned things will help you make your life hereafter better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
